explication: Superset is a desktop workspace for running coding agents in parallel and reviewing their work. The documented workflow is to add a repository, create a workspace, launch an agent, inspect and revise its changes, preview the app, then commit or push. The tree supports the desktop’s workspace, Git, browser, and terminal layers; README-described capabilities such as scheduled automations and mobile are represented where matching runtime paths are visible. Several feature paths are unsampled, so uncertain implementation links are omitted.
